snippet.title: Shrink Rooms Demo Out! Surviving From Deadly Puzzle Test!
snippet.description:
["Shrink Rooms Demo" has been released! Try and pass the test!]

Shrink Rooms is a round-based puzzle game. You need to solve a series of pushing box puzzles within a limited number of steps to escape, otherwise you will be crushed into a puddle of meat by shrinking walls of the level.

Psychological Evaluation Required:
- Stage1: Spatial Memory Test (82% failure rate)
- Stage2: Polymer Experiment
- Hidden Stage: Portal Wall Simulation
WARNING: This test may permanently alter your brain waves.

Add to Steam Wishlist for more detail!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3409430/Shrink_Rooms/?utm_source=youtube
